<!--
A benchmark is a full revision of a stock assessment, done at a workshop on a three-to-five
year cycle. It is not an annual assessment: the question is not "what is the state of the
stock" but "is this the right assessment, and what should replace it".

The workshop's most important product is the STOCK ANNEX — the settings the annual
assessment will use until the next benchmark. Write the annex as the deliverable and the
chapter as the argument for it.

Sections follow the ICES benchmark structure: data sources and quality, environmental and
ecosystem issues, assessment methods explored, forecast, reference points, the recommended
changes to the stock annex, and recommendations for future work. The external reviewers'
report and the issue list are compiled by the workshop, not by the stock coordinator, and
are referenced rather than written here.

Confirm the current structure against the workshop's terms of reference and the most recent
ICES benchmark reports before using this skeleton — the sections are stable, the details
are not.
-->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
source(here::here("R", "report_helpers.R"))
```

```{r benchmark-values}
#| include: false
#| eval: false

# chapter compares several candidate models, so keep one object per candidate and derive
# the comparison rather than typing it.
```
